scientific_integrity: The universal assertions are proved analytically. Finite numerical tests are illustrative rather than certificates for all dimensions. Closest primary literature includes a numerical comparison, but a universal covering theorem was not located; historical originality is assessed on available evidence, not formally certified.
scientific_limitations: Real positive-definite matrices, common full-column-rank deterministic sketch, exact powers and arithmetic. Eigenvalue comparison holds for positive powers, nuclear residual comparison only for strictly concave powers. Singular-matrix/pseudoinverse variants, Frobenius/operator residual dominance, floating-point stability, and typical-case Gaussian advantage are not established.
title: Deterministic spectral dominance of funNyström for fractional matrix powers
